Select distinct compound ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES for molecules reported in document CHEMBL5795593. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5795593'. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
